summary:
The guest book app is built on `desk:apps:book` and works in my test: it opens showing "0 guests", names added with Enter appear newest first, Backspace edits the typed name, and Enter with nothing typed does nothing.

I used the 41-line app page as the guest book, reading `desk:guestbook` at the start of each step and adding names with `add`. I also tested it by adding "Mira" and "Tom", which left `desk:guestbook` with those two lines. I did not touch `desk:apps` beyond the new page, and the app reads nothing from it.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest book'
task guests()
set names to []
when exists('desk:guestbook')
for each ln in lines(read('desk:guestbook'))
when ln is not ''
add ln to names
done
done
done
give names
done
task start()
give {names: guests(), typed: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
set names to guests()
set typed to s.typed
when k is 'enter'
when typed is not ''
add('desk:guestbook', typed)
add typed to names
set typed to ''
done
or when count(k) is 1 or k is 'backspace'
set typed to edit_text(typed, k)
done
give {names: names, typed: typed}
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, count(s.names) & ' guests')
set row to 3
for each nm in reverse(s.names)
when row <= 22
show(row, 3, nm)
set row to row + 1
done
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
help('Enter adds the name  Backspace erases')
done
